name: source_backed_visible_food_eval
description: Public-source image examples for testing visible-food recognition. Expected labels are intentionally conservative; source URLs and direct image URLs come from Wikimedia Commons.
source_policy: Use for evaluation only; respect each image's linked license and attribution.
